Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 2 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 3 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 4 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 5 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import asyncio
import json
import os
from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Optional

from google.cloud import speech
from google.cloud.speech_v1 import RecognitionConfig, StreamingRecognitionConfig, StreamingRecognizeRequest


class StreamingSpeechToText:
    def __init__(
        self,
        language_code: str = "en-US",
        sample_rate_hertz: int = 16000,
        encoding: int = speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        interim_results: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.client = speech.SpeechAsyncClient()
        self.config = RecognitionConfig(
            encoding=encoding,
            sample_rate_hertz=sample_rate_hertz,
            language_code=language_code,
        )
        self.streaming_config = StreamingRecognitionConfig(
            config=self.config,
            interim_results=interim_results,
            single_utterance=False,
        )

    async def transcribe(
        self,
        audio_chunks: AsyncIterator[bytes],
        on_transcript: Optional[Callable[[str, bool], Awaitable[None]]] = None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        async def request_generator() -> AsyncIterator[StreamingRecognizeRequest]:
            yield StreamingRecognizeRequest(streaming_config=self.streaming_config)
            async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                if chunk:
                    yield StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)

        transcripts: list[str] = []

        responses = await self.client.streaming_recognize(requests=request_generator())
        async for response in responses:
            if not response.results:
                continue
            for result in response.results:
                if not result.alternatives:
                    continue
                transcript = result.alternatives[0].transcript
                if transcript:
                    transcripts.append(transcript)
                    if on_transcript is not None:
                        await on_transcript(transcript, result.is_final)

        return transcripts


async def _async_source_from_bytes(data: bytes, chunk_size: int = 4096, delay: float = 0.0) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
    for i in range(0, len(data), chunk_size):
        if delay:
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        yield data[i : i + chunk_size]


async def stream_audio_chunks(audio_source: AsyncIterator[bytes]) -> list[str]:
    stt = StreamingSpeechToText(
        language_code=os.getenv("SPEECH_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
        sample_rate_hertz=int(os.getenv("SPEECH_SAMPLE_RATE_HERTZ", "16000")),
    )
    return await stt.transcribe(audio_source)


async def main() -> None:
    audio_path = os.getenv("AUDIO_PATH")
    if not audio_path:
        raise RuntimeError("AUDIO_PATH environment variable is required")

    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
        audio_data = f.read()

    async def source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        async for chunk in _async_source_from_bytes(audio_data, chunk_size=4096, delay=0.0):
            yield chunk

    async def print_transcript(text: str, is_final: bool) -> None:
        payload = {"text": text, "final": is_final}
        print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))

    stt = StreamingSpeechToText(
        language_code=os.getenv("SPEECH_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
        sample_rate_hertz=int(os.getenv("SPEECH_SAMPLE_RATE_HERTZ", "16000")),
    )
    await stt.transcribe(source(), on_transcript=print_transcript)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
